preserved_behavior: Responsive dark mode layout, session state store in Zustand, cookie handling.
changed_behavior: Clean Login/Register flow with redirection, expandable B2B section in Profile, and a new Change Password form inside Profile Settings.
user_goal: Secure access and editing of customer account credentials and personal profiles.

B2B form inputs must dynamically update aria-hidden attributes depending on toggle state.
Form labels must map explicitly to their input ids.

Change password PUT endpoint returns success: true

Fetch and save profile personal/B2B/GDPR fields
